Context: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

## FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS  
1. What is the amount of standard deduction allowed to individuals on total income? ~ 50,000 or the amount of salary, whichever is less.
2. What is the quantum of Transport Allowance exempt from tax? ~ 3,200 per month of Transport Allowance granted to an employee who is blind, deaf, dumb or orthopaedically handicapped with disability of lower extremities is exempt from tax.
